files.caption: Two photographs of 3005 Sheldon Road, Middletown, Ohio. Photographs are undated. The real estate listing for 3005 Sheldon Road reads: A different and distinctive home with all the pleasing features that are shown in the better home magazines. Has six rooms - one floor plan. The large living room has log-burning fireplace surrounded by mirror from floor to ceiling. Charming dining room, three bedrooms, many closets, bath with tile shower. Step-saving kitchen. Complete basement with automatic gas
